svg.aria-label: Primary succession over time: bare rock, then lichens and mosses, then grasses and shrubs, then a young forest, while the soil layer thickens
svg.title: Ecological succession from bare rock to forest

g.text: Pioneers break down rock and add organic matter, building soil that lets larger plants take over;
each community changes conditions (shade, soil depth, moisture) in favour of the next.
Secondary succession (after fire or clearing) starts at stage 3 because the soil survives.
